profile_text.body:
Kyndryl is a public company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York, NY, USA, that trades under the ticker KD. On its own site the company says it designs, builds, manages and modernizes the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day.

Its site gives considerable attention to AI and workforce topics. Kyndryl publishes a People Readiness Report, described as exploring why workforce readiness has become one of the most important factors determining AI success, and a 2026 edition of that report is said to reveal a decline in workforce readiness as AI adoption surges. The site also discusses AI-native enterprises that put AI at the core of their business, a podcast from The Innovation Show and The Kyndryl Institute on how AI is evolving business models, and the view that as geopolitical tensions escalate and AI accelerates attackers' capabilities, organizations must rethink what resilience looks like.

The company's record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile lists a CIK of 0001867072, and its law exposure is recorded against New York, with a count of 459.
